headline: Paid before the harvest, not after
body: Wayfarer pays farmers a fixed price before the coffee is even picked. No gamble on how the season sells, for them or for you.

headline: We'll tell you when a lot isn't great
body: This season's lot from Huila was a little uneven, we said so in the notes. That's the kind of coffee company we are.

headline: Where did your coffee actually come from?
body: Every bag lists the farm, the date it was paid for, and the price. No guessing, no vague sourcing claims.

headline: Coffee subscriptions, minus the mystery
body: You get a traceable bag every month and a farmer who got paid weeks before harvest. That's the whole pitch.

headline: Try it. Cancel it. No hard feelings.
body: Your first bag is free with any plan. If it's not for you, cancel before the next one ships.

headline: Most coffee brands wait to see if it sells
body: We pay farmers upfront, before harvest, regardless of how the season turns out. It costs us more. We think it's worth it.

headline: This season's lot: Nariño, picked in April
body: Bright, a little tart, nothing fancy about how we're describing it. Paid for in February, before a single cherry was picked.

headline: What does 'fair price' actually mean here?
body: It means farmers are paid before harvest, at a fixed rate, whether the crop is excellent or just okay.

headline: No poetry, just paperwork you can check
body: Every subscription includes the purchase date, the price paid, and the farm name. Ask us anything, we'll show you the receipts.

headline: Your coffee, unhurried and traceable
body: We're not chasing trends or rushing harvests. Just a steady, fairly paid supply chain and a bag that shows up when it says it will.

headline: A mediocre harvest still means a paid farmer
body: Some seasons are better than others. Either way, the farmer already got paid before the first cherry was picked.

headline: First bag's on us
body: Start any Wayfarer plan and the first bag is free. Cancel whenever, no questions.

headline: We paid for this season's lot in March
body: It ships to you in June. That gap is the whole point, farmers get paid before demand is even known.

headline: Not artisanal. Just accountable.
body: We're not going to describe our coffee's journey. We'll just tell you who grew it, when they got paid, and how much.

headline: Compare our contract to theirs
body: Most coffee brands pay after the harvest sells. We pay before it's picked. Read the difference for yourself.

headline: One bag, one farm, one straight answer
body: We don't blend lots to hide a bad season. If it's this season's harvest, you'll know exactly whose it is.

headline: Coffee that doesn't ask you to hurry
body: No countdowns, no 'last chance' bags. Just a subscription you can start, pause, or leave whenever it suits you.

headline: Ask us what 'paid before harvest' costs us
body: It means we take on the risk of a bad season instead of the farmer. We'll tell you the numbers if you want them.

headline: A subscription with nothing to hide
body: Traceable lots, upfront payment dates, and a first bag that's free. That's the whole offer, no fine print.

headline: Try this season's lot before you commit
body: Get your first bag free with any plan and decide for yourself if it's worth staying. Cancel anytime if it's not.
